page.name: Arctic Wolf
page.title: Security operations built around your risk
page.intro: Arctic Wolf’s Aurora platform brings together security signals, AI-assisted investigation and human expertise to help teams detect threats, prioritize risks and respond to incidents.
page.partnerIntro: Tri-Point is an Arctic Wolf Bronze Pack Partner. Share your current tools, coverage gaps and procurement needs so we can help scope the right services for your organization.
page.useCaseIntro: Start with the services, devices and data your organization needs to protect. Then identify where your team needs more visibility or response support.

useCases.title: State and local government
useCases.description: Review monitoring for public services, shared infrastructure and distributed departments. Define who will receive alerts and who can act on them.

useCases.title: Education
useCases.description: Plan coverage for campus networks, staff devices and cloud services. Consider training needs and how to handle incidents outside the school day.

useCases.title: Regulated organizations
useCases.description: For financial and healthcare teams, review how monitoring and incident support fit your sensitive data, existing controls and reporting obligations.

page.catalogIntro: Start with the security gap you need to address. Each inquiry gives Tri-Point the service context for a more focused conversation.
page.scopeNote: Features, integrations, licensing, coverage and availability depend on the selected services and your environment. Tri-Point confirms the proposed scope and commercial terms by quotation.
page.planningTitle: Start with what you need to protect
page.planningIntro: Share a high-level picture of your environment and what you need to improve. Tri-Point can help turn that into a scoped inquiry.

planning.title: Map your environment
planning.description: Identify the endpoints, cloud services, networks and tools you already use. Note the teams responsible for them.

planning.title: Prioritize the gaps
planning.description: Decide whether you need stronger monitoring, endpoint protection, exposure management, training or incident response.

planning.title: Confirm the scope
planning.description: Review supported integrations, deployment requirements, response responsibilities, licensing and timing before requesting a quote.

questions.question: Can Arctic Wolf work with the tools we already use?
questions.answer: Arctic Wolf publishes supported integrations for security data and response. Share the products and versions you use so we can confirm what the proposed service supports.

questions.question: Which service provides around-the-clock monitoring?
questions.answer: Aurora Managed Detection and Response includes 24×7 monitoring. Confirm which data sources will be monitored and what actions Arctic Wolf and your team will each handle.

questions.question: How does incident response coverage work?
questions.answer: Arctic Wolf offers incident response services and retainer options. Discuss readiness needs, the response terms, escalation contacts and any insurer requirements before selecting coverage.

questions.question: What should I include in my inquiry?
questions.answer: Share your approximate device or user count, current security tools, priority concerns and procurement timeline. Keep credentials, logs and sensitive incident details out of the form.

products.name: Aurora Managed Detection and Response
products.description: Add around-the-clock threat monitoring and investigation across supported endpoints, networks and cloud services. Arctic Wolf’s security team helps interpret findings and coordinate the response.
products.imageAlt: Signal trace passing through a detection and investigation grid

specs.Scope to review: Data sources, alert escalation and which response actions the teams will handle.

products.name: Aurora Endpoint Security
products.description: Protect supported devices with endpoint prevention, detection and response. Explore the coverage and management options that fit your device fleet and security team.
products.imageAlt: Connected desktop and mobile devices around a central shield

specs.Scope to review: Device types, operating systems, existing endpoint tools and management responsibilities.

products.name: Aurora Vulnerability Management
products.description: Identify vulnerabilities in your environment and prioritize which findings to fix. A consolidated risk view helps teams track remediation work across affected assets.
products.imageAlt: Three ranked rows representing vulnerability findings

specs.Scope to review: Assets to scan, scan methods and how findings reach the team responsible for remediation.

products.name: Aurora Attack Surface Management
products.description: Discover internet-facing assets and review what they expose. Use this view to investigate external risks across domains and services that may sit outside your usual inventory.
products.imageAlt: An external network with nodes surrounding a discovery boundary

specs.Scope to review: Domains, public services and responsibility for investigating and addressing findings.

products.name: Aurora Security Awareness and Training
products.description: Help employees recognize and report common threats through short lessons and phishing simulations. Use reporting to identify where more training may help.
products.imageAlt: A training panel showing a phishing message and a reporting action

specs.Scope to review: User groups, training cadence, simulation requirements and reporting needs.

products.name: Aurora Incident Response Services
products.description: Plan for specialist support during a cyber incident. Explore assistance with investigation, containment and recovery, as well as readiness work available through retainer options.
products.imageAlt: A response timeline with investigation, containment and recovery milestones

specs.Scope to review: Escalation contacts, coverage terms, recovery responsibilities and insurer requirements.
